body:
Watch the Vowel Change: 1. tape 2. pine 3. note 4. The e at the end (Magic E) makes the u say its name.
Make It Magic: 1. cane 2. ride 3. robe 4. tube 5. made.
Draw the Magic Word: any final-e word, such as kite, cake, bike, rose, cube, cone, plane.
Short or Long?: 1. short 2. long 3. long 4. short 5. home, read with a long o.
Scoring tip: a student who writes the right answer but reads the word with a short vowel is Getting there on "I read the word".
title: Answer key: Magic E: Long Vowels
